response.sql: WITH standings_with_previous AS (SELECT r.raceId, c.country, ds.wins, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ds.driverId, r.year ORDER BY r.round, r.raceId) AS standing_number, LAG(ds.wins) OVER (PARTITION BY ds.driverId, r.year ORDER BY r.round, r.raceId) AS previous_wins FROM driverStandings AS ds JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId WHERE c.country IS NOT NULL), race_averages AS (SELECT country, raceId, AVG(wins - CASE WHEN standing_number = 1 THEN 0 ELSE previous_wins END) AS race_average FROM standings_with_previous GROUP BY country, raceId), country_averages AS (SELECT country, AVG(race_average) AS country_average FROM race_averages GROUP BY country), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(country_average) AS overall_average FROM country_averages), above_benchmark AS (SELECT ca.country, ca.country_average, b.overall_average FROM country_averages AS ca CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE ca.country_average > b.overall_average), second_benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(country_average) AS second_average FROM above_benchmark) SELECT a.country, a.country_average AS average, a.country_average - a.overall_average AS above_overall_benchmark, a.country_average - s.second_average AS above_second_mean FROM above_benchmark AS a CROSS JOIN second_benchmark AS s WHERE a.country_average > s.second_average ORDER BY a.country;
